svg.title: Overfilled square collimated beam
svg.desc: A 70 by 70 millimetre square beam makes a 98.99 by 70 millimetre footprint on the splitter. The MV-150 clear interface clips the fold direction, leaving a 55 by 70 millimetre rectangular outgoing beam rather than 38.9 by 70.
svg.text: Case 3 — overfilled square: rectangular aperture clipping
